release_note.behavior: Recursive Division uses the corrected open-area single-gap model and is now documented and gated as a deterministic perfect Maze generator.
release_note.api: byul_maze_generate_recursive_division adds replayable seed, cancellation, max_steps, max_cells, status, and failure-atomic output controls.
release_note.compatibility: maze_make_recursive_division remains exported as a deprecated ABI 1.x forwarder. Equal checked seeds preserve the corrected pre-API raster order.
